title: English Practice Quiz 0957
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The expression 'on the same page' means ___.
questions.explanation: It means people understand and agree about a situation.

questions.question: If someone is 'under the weather', they feel ___.
questions.explanation: Under the weather is an informal expression meaning unwell.

questions.question: To 'get the ball rolling' means to ___.
The expression 'in the long run' refers to ___.
options: over a long period of time
at the end of a queue
questions.explanation: It refers to the eventual or long-term result.

questions.question: To 'call it a day' means to ___.
options: stop working for the time being
questions.explanation: The phrase means finish work or an activity for now.

questions.question: If something happens 'at the eleventh hour', it happens ___.
questions.explanation: It means just before a deadline or too late.

questions.question: To 'keep someone posted' means to ___.
options: remove them from a mailing list
questions.explanation: Keep someone posted means provide updates.

questions.question: The phrase 'back to square one' means ___.
questions.explanation: It means having to start again from the beginning.

questions.question: To 'make ends meet' means to ___.
options: manage financially with the money available
questions.explanation: It means having enough money to cover basic expenses.

questions.question: If a plan is 'up in the air', it is ___.
questions.explanation: Up in the air means uncertain or undecided.
